## Part 0 — Position Statement

Paradigm is not a generative app. Paradigm is the operating substrate of generated reality: a deterministic, evolvable, sovereign kernel that can compress any creative artifact — a game, a song, a film, a novel, a building, a molecule, a culture — into a `.gseed`, breed seeds with seeds, render across modalities, and let operators own what they make at the substrate level.

The previous canon (vision documents, sovereign agent canon, GSPL spec, OS doctrine) describes what Paradigm wants to be. This doctrine describes what finishing it actually requires: which files are unfinished, which contracts are unspecified, which invariants exist only as aspirations, and which phases must ship in which order before the substrate is real.

Three things must be true at completion:

1. **The kernel never lies.** Same gseed → same artifact across runtime, hash, render, replay. Forever. Across machines, decades, civilizations.
2. **The operator owns the substrate.** No central server is required. The kernel runs offline. Royalties accrue without a marketplace gatekeeper. Forking is a first-class right.
3. **The substrate is universal.** Game, song, film, building, organism, culture — all are compositions over the same nine strata, all rendered by the same kernel, all evolvable by the same operators.

If any of those three becomes false, Paradigm has failed regardless of how much it ships.

> *"What I want is a sovereign substrate where anyone can compose reality and own what they compose, forever."*

This doctrine is the executable form of that sentence.

### Honest Assessment
Paradigm Absolute v1.0.0 is a **real, production-grade, deterministic seed platform** with a working sovereign creation loop and sophisticated intelligence scaffolding. It is an excellent foundation.

Doctrine v2 correctly reframes v1.0.0 as Phase 0 of a much larger "Paradigm Infinite" vision (the operating substrate of generated reality, 9 strata, federation, economic layer, 1M-game corpus, 12 hero flagships, OS Shell, recursive closure).

This document (13_*) is now the governing canon for all future work. All prior planning in `planning/` remains valuable execution history but is subordinated to this doctrine. Future phases will produce `planning/DOCTRINE_V2_MAPPING.md` and `14_*` successors only when invariants must change.

**No evasion.** The Spine (determinism, sovereignty, quality, forkability) is non-negotiable from this point forward.
